status: Derived/reviewed opportunity; not implemented or speed-qualified
purpose: Replace time-differenced operator/geometry pressure recovery with a current-domain harmonic BVP.

eulerian_acceleration_potential.physical_free_surface: chi=-g eta-0.5|u|^2 in fixed Bernoulli gauge
eulerian_acceleration_potential.body: dn chi = n dot (A+alpha cross r+Omega cross (Omega cross r)) + (Omega cross n) dot (V-u) - n dot Hessian(phi) V

rigid_transport.harmonicity: laplacian(V dot grad(phi))=2 grad(V):Hessian(phi)=0 because grad(V) is skew and Hessian(phi) symmetric
rigid_transport.body: dn zeta = n dot (A+alpha cross r-Omega cross U)
rigid_transport.second_derivation: In body coordinates Phi_b(a,t)=phi(X(t)+R(t)a,t), zeta=partial_t Phi_b at fixed a. Differentiate fixed body normal condition; d(R^T U)/dt=R^T(A-Omega cross U), d(Omega_body)/dt=R^T alpha.

fourier_transport_split.reason: Omega cross r is not periodic. Direct transformed free-surface data can introduce artificial seams into fixed-world FFT/HOS.
fourier_transport_split.decomposition: Current phi=H+R, H the known harmonic Fourier lift and R the current aperiodic paired-body source field. Let T=V dot grad and Z=zeta-T H=chi+T R.
fourier_transport_split.body: dn Z = n dot(A+alpha cross r-Omega cross U) - (Omega cross n) dot u_H - n dot Hessian(H) V
fourier_transport_split.cheap_fourier_normal_derivative: For d=(i kx,i ky,|k|), mode normal derivative of TH is P times [(Omega cross n) dot d + (n dot d)(V dot d)]. No source Hessian required.
fourier_transport_split.remaining_limit: Body-source boundary terms remain aperiodic; boundary/domain and HOS truncation controls remain necessary. Do not mix exact continued flat-term gradients with different formal surface-Taylor orders without reporting the defect.

implicit_body_coupling.current_system: Aop sigma = b_known + W acceleration, with W the six current rigid normal modes
implicit_body_coupling.body_system: M acceleration + C sigma = f_known, C=rho W^T D S_eff
implicit_body_coupling.eliminated_system: (Aop+W M^-1 C) sigma = b_known+W M^-1 f_known; acceleration=M^-1(f_known-C sigma)
implicit_body_coupling.ownership: Apply the rank-six correction using the same current source/graph response; no symmetry or SPD repair. Known load includes the lift, kinetic/gravity pressure exactly once, body gravity and world gyro load.
implicit_body_coupling.qualification: An alternative to seven decomposed acceleration BVPs; no implementation or runtime claim yet.

warnings: PDE-consistent AP is not algebraically identical to differentiating the finite P0/HOS approximation; require spatial/force convergence, not roundoff matching to FD.
Existing owned full-stage h/h2 pressure gate is the independent reference for a prescribed case. Begin with pure translation, then oblique rotation with the transport split.
Keep artificial damping/sponge state rates separate from physical free-surface pressure unless the forcing model is explicit.
This does not fix the unresolved finite-frequency spatial roll defect, P1/Fourier mismatch, or newly exposed exterior-state transfer.
independent_review: Two agents independently derived chi and rigid-transport BCs, including the centripetal cancellation and minus Omega cross U sign. No numerical test of AP yet.

primary_sources.title: Tanizawa1995, A Nonlinear Simulation Method of3-D Body Motions in Waves (1stReport)
primary_sources.supports: Established acceleration-potential/current-domain nonlinear body coupling; alternative Laplace formulation. Do not confuse Prandtl nonlinear acceleration potential with harmonic phi_t.

primary_sources.supports: Modal n+1 acceleration solves and body-fixed free-surface complications.
